issue.title: Gate turns: explicit carry-vs-commit and visible accepted-but-failed executions
issue.description: Agents staging inheriting gate turns know dirty work is carried uncommitted unless they declare commit, and a gate whose accepted option command failed is visibly failed and recoverable on every surface instead of silently parking in a Running "settling" state.
